candidates.rationale: Vstd's borrowed-key predicates are opaque and non-functional for generic Borrow<Q>, so they cannot uniquely relate the observable stored-key reference to the query.

The exact partition requires comparing each stored key's borrowed Q with key. Vstd models borrowed-key containment but not Borrow::borrow or cross-type ordering, leaving absent-key boundaries underdetermined.
Vstd cannot express the cross-type ordering between a stored T's borrowed Q and value, so it cannot determine the returned suffix when value is absent.

pub assume_specification<R: core::ops::RangeBounds<usize>>[
    alloc::string::String::replace_range::<R>
](
    s: &mut alloc::string::String,
    range: R,
    replace_with: &str,
)
    requires
        slice_range_valid(&range, encode_utf8(old(s)@).len()),
        is_char_boundary(encode_utf8(old(s)@), slice_range_start(&range)),
        is_char_boundary(encode_utf8(old(s)@), slice_range_end(&range, encode_utf8(old(s)@).len())),
    ensures
        final(s)@ == decode_utf8(encode_utf8(old(s)@).subrange(0, slice_range_start(&range)))
            + replace_with@
            + decode_utf8(encode_utf8(old(s)@).subrange(
                slice_range_end(&range, encode_utf8(old(s)@).len()),
                encode_utf8(old(s)@).len() as int,
            )),
;
